description: P36 (plan M6-M9 §5.4, §5.5, §5.7, §5.13): Fort Aldmere's main gate between its bastions - iron-bound timber 18 m wide and 12 m tall. A stage-4 giant breaches it (the crown's breach path: Aldmere's gate is its fortress, so every blow on it is an offence against Aldmere and its garrison takes up arms); the crown's parley opens it without a blow (open_when_flag world.aldmere.fort_open), so a friend walks into the bailey and to the fort's forge. Breached, it opens the way to the Iron Regiment's bailey.
locked_message: Fortified gates can be breached at stage 4.
